content:
infra-bot: ALERT: autoscaler for cluster gpu-pool-3 hit configured max_nodes=60. queue depth for /v1/generate spiked to 9k. throttling started, 503s observed. tagging as P1.
Marco (oncall): I'm on it. Pulling up metrics now.
Priya R.: Seeing sustained 95% GPU utilization across nodes + long pod pending times. Autoscaler refused to create new nodes — hit cloud quota.
Sam G.: Can we do a temporary manual increase of the node pool? cloud-quotas look ok but VM quota for GPUs is at account limit.
Ellen H.: Paging cloud infra team for a quota bump, filing support ticket. In meantime, we should triage customer impact and slow down low-priority jobs.
Marco (oncall): Agreed. Enabling priority routing to favor enterprise routes. Also enabling conservative cache hits to reduce token usage.
ops-lead: If cloud cannot raise quota immediately, we can do a manual node-add in another region and route traffic there as fallback. That needs a quick canary config change.
Priya R.: Steps I ran locally:
```
# show pending pods
kubectl -n inference get pods | grep Pending | wc -l
# current nodepool size
gcloud container node-pools describe gpu-pool-3 --cluster=prod-cluster --format=json | jq .autoscaling
```
Sam G.: Support ticket submitted (INC-8472). ETA from cloud support ~25-35m for quota raise. They asked for justification and expected transient usage.
Marco (oncall): While we wait, I'm going to manually scale down some internal non-prod jobs and push low-priority requests to model-small fallback. Deploying a routing rule now.
Customer Support: Notifying affected customers (we have ~12 customer-facing errors reported, mainly higher latency and occasional 503). Escalating to account teams for top 3 enterprise customers.
infra-bot: NOTE: recorded spike: queue=9000, avg latency=2.6s -> 12s during surge. Error rate rose from 0.2% -> 4.1%.
Ellen H.: Cloud just replied: temporary GPU quota increase approved to 80 for 2 hours. They require manual nodepool resize from our side.
Marco (oncall): On it. Doing manual nodepool resize to +20 nodes in gpu-pool-3. Command:
```
gcloud container clusters resize prod-cluster --node-pool=gpu-pool-3 --num-nodes=80 --region=us-central1
```
Priya R.: I'm watching pod backlog. New nodes starting; pods scheduling. Kernels warming.
Sam G.: Routing change in effect, low-priority queued to model-small. Traffic to premium models prioritized.
ops-lead: Keep an eye on preemption risk and spot instance churn. We should prefer on-demand if possible for this bump.
infra-bot: New capacity observed. queue dropped from 9k -> 1.2k in 8 minutes. error rate falling.
Marco (oncall): Thanks team. I'm marking as "mitigated" but not closed. We'll keep extra nodes for 60 minutes and then scale back to 60.
Customer Support: Updated customers: mitigation in place, sustained improvement. Continuing to collect logs for postmortem.
Ellen H.: Postmortem action items: 1) raise autoscaler max_nodes default for gpu-pool-3 to 100 behind an approval guard, 2) add an automated fallback that routes low-priority to model-small after queue > 2k, 3) run quota audit and request baseline GPU quota increases for prod account.
Marco (oncall): I'll write a short timeline and drop in #postmortems. Can someone draft the customer-facing incident note?
Customer Support: I'll take the customer note and coordinate with account teams.
Sam G.: Leaving a note here: risk of cost spike accepted for 2-hour window to protect SLA for paying customers.
infra-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Open follow-ups tracked in INC-8472 and PM-482.
Marco (oncall): closing handoff to oncall rotation tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
